name: Alternating Hang Clean
setup: Stand over a kettlebell with feet hip-width, hinge back and take the handle with a loose hook grip.
cues: Hike the bell back, then snap the hips through to float it up close.

cautions: Technical lift: learn the swing first.

name: Backward Medicine Ball Throw

Rest longer: every throw should be the fastest one yet.

name: Clean
setup: Feet under the hips, hands just outside the legs on the bar, shins close to it.
cues: Push the floor away, then jump straight up with the bar close.
Meet the bar on the front of the shoulders with the elbows ripping forward fast.

Whip the elbows forward to point at the wall ahead.

cautions: Technical lift: learn it with a coach and an empty bar first.
